title: DNS Resolution Failures — CoreDNS Pod Crash
symptom: Services unable to resolve internal cluster DNS names; intermittent NXDOMAIN errors in application logs; CoreDNS pods in CrashLoopBackOff in kube-system namespace.
remediation_steps: Check CoreDNS pod status: kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns
Inspect crash logs: kubectl logs -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns --tail=100
Restart CoreDNS: kubectl rollout restart deployment/coredns -n kube-system
Verify resolution from test pod: kubectl run dnstest --image=busybox --restart=Never -- nslookup kubernetes.default
If persistent, inspect ConfigMap: kubectl describe configmap coredns -n kube-system
